verdicts.typography: Excellent typographic hierarchy and Swiss-style discipline. Mono uppercase labels are perfectly applied. One minor nitpick: the stat strip numbers (8, 8, 3, 6) could use slightly tighter tracking to match the ultra-precise feel of the micro-labels above them.
verdicts.color: Flawless execution of the minimalist palette. Single restrained red accent (#E53935 or similar) used consistently for emphasis, status indicators, and interactive elements. Near-black on white provides excellent contrast. No off-brand colors or visual noise detected.
verdicts.layout: Strong grid alignment and generous whitespace rhythm throughout. The hairline borders on the matrix table and analysis cards are clean. Minor deduction because the footer is not visible in any screenshot to confirm it's pinned to the document bottom as specified.
verdicts.components: High-quality component design. The matrix table uses clear iconography (solid red, dashed, empty) with a well-highlighted final column. The accordion list shows good affordance with chevrons and red dot indicators. The sticky header and stat strip are well-implemented. One small observation: the '1 Issue' button in the bottom-left has a subtle shadow that slightly violates the strict no-shadow rule.
verdicts.responsive: Strong mobile layout and dark-mode execution, but a persistent floating UI element ('1 Issue') overlaps content and obscures text in multiple sections, preventing a flawless score.

typography: Reduce letter-spacing (tracking) on the large stat strip numerals (8, 8, 3, 6) by approximately -0.02em to achieve a more compact, engineered look consistent with the mono-label aesthetic.
layout: Ensure the footer element uses `min-h-screen` flexbox layout or similar to guarantee it sits at the document bottom even on short content pages.
components: Remove the box-shadow from the '1 Issue' floating action button to strictly adhere to the flat, shadowless Swiss-style design system.
responsive: Reposition or hide the floating '1 Issue' toast/notification on mobile viewports (390px) to prevent it from obscuring body copy (e.g., in 'The Field', 'The Matrix', 'Analysis', and 'Verdict' sections).
